en.topic_title: Top US, China officials raise trade ‘concerns’ as APEC approaches
en.topic_summary:
Top officials from Washington and Beijing held “frank” talks on their countries’ testy trade relationship on Friday, ahead of an Asia-Pacific summit in China this month where their leaders are due to meet.



A man uses his phone next to signage for the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) China 2026 summit in Shenzhen, southern China’s Guangdong province on November 3, 2026. Photo: Hector Retamal/AFP.
